reviews.title: Best airline in NZ!!
reviews.text: Always great service and staff. Lifesaver for getting family home after recent ferry disruption. Could not have been better to deal with. Great fare options, some of which have a great cancelation policy. Highly recommend and always our first choice to get to Blenheim. Such a good kiwi company.
reviews.author: clarenz

reviews.title: Save my holiday
reviews.text: Sounds Air pulled through in a pinch when my ferry from Wellington to Picton had been cancelled. I'm only in New Zealand for one week so all my bookings were very tight and left no room for errors. Perhaps that was my first mistake but my second had been not to just initially book with Sounds Air! They're small but mighty and even though I wasn't able to make my bus to Kaikoura, I was able to meet a friendly Kiwi willing to take me themself. Holiday saved.
reviews.author: emilyguebert

reviews.title: Beware if you're the only person booked on a flight
reviews.text: Sounds Air cancelled my evening flight from Wellington to Taupo in July of 2021, apparently due to low cloud cover in Taupo. Phoned my parents in Taupo who confirmed there was no cloud cover at all in Taupo, with clear skies over the airport even. Every other scheduled Sounds Air flight out of Wellington went ahead on time, along with every other domestic flight out of Wellington. So it obviously wasn't a weather issue in Wellington or Taupo. Only real reason I could think of as to why they cancelled the flight was because I was the only passenger booked and it wouldn't be profitable on their side. Lady at check-in counter tried to claim that this wasn't the case as their morning flights leaving Taupo were also affected, but I couldn't think of any other logical reason when there were clear skies in Taupo over the airport. Only offer made to me was a flight the next day or credit. Supposedly they couldn't even help me find accommodation for the night, not even a refund as it was a 'weather related issue.' Disappointed and will not be using their service again.
reviews.author: T Walker

reviews.title: Won’t refund flights
reviews.text: Be careful with sounds air and booking flights. I’ve had to cancel my flights because the trip we are on is being canceled. And what would you know they can only offer a credit.
reviews.author: Slippery_d

reviews.title: best little airline in NZ
reviews.text: very impressed with Sounds Air, I did a 1 day return flight Taupo > Wellington > Taupo. fantastic 9 seater aircraft, very smooth flight apart from the in and out of Wellington which is notoriously bumpy on ant aircraft. Could not fault the experience, the staff and crew were so helpful and professional. I will definitely be using this service again, it was absolutely brilliant.
reviews.author: Derek S

reviews.title: Too easy , flying like it should be
reviews.text: This is flying, the price of the flight from Wanaka to Christchurch is worth it for the scenery alone. Amazing service, amazing crew. The landing was the best ever.
reviews.author: Steve Mc

reviews.title: Here to there and back again three days later.
reviews.text: Very efficient, timing was good. Friendly staff, easy check-in. No frills, but a perfect way to get across the Strait. Could be hard to get in if you are elderly or not so agile. We had a smooth, quick flight. We noticed a few people had transported their animals (in cages of a designated size). Long term parking at the airport made the whole experience super easy for us! We booked online, easy process. Limited flights to choose from, not offering all services every day. We just worked our holiday around our booking. Price, not so cheap but for the convenience it was worth it!
reviews.author: Rebecca W

reviews.title: First Class Customer Service
reviews.text: Sounds Air flies me to Wellington for work every week. The customer service is first class, stellar views and great prices. It's a real pleasure to fly Sounds Air.
reviews.author: Susan Shaw

reviews.title: Lovely staff
reviews.text: Lovely staff, great slights over all the wineries. Small plane with not much space. Probably could offer candy as my wife had trouble unblocking her ears which became quite uncomfortable. Flew from Wellington which is an artwork in itself
reviews.author: Darius Goodhew

reviews.title: Real flying:)
reviews.text: This is a 12 seater plane, so you have a real flying experience. But you do need to be able to scramble into your seat - not good for the mobility impaired.
reviews.author: HKinsey

reviews.title: Return trip
reviews.text: Take off from Wellington in zero wind was in complete contrast to our landing there two weeks previously. The journey was swift and comfortable in this 9 seater aircraft. Brilliant way to travel speedily from A to B.
reviews.author: Margo L

reviews.title: Sporty landing in Wellington
reviews.text: We flew down to Wellington with Sounds Air . A picturesque journey of about an hour. The pilot, on enquiry from another passenger suggested that the landing might be 'sporty' Wellington being notoriously windy. This pilot is my all time heroine, she executed the challenging landing perfectly. I should say I'm not usually great in anything smaller than a Dreamliner.
reviews.author: Margo L

reviews.title: Surprise flight
reviews.text: We traveled from Wellington to Picton on the 31st jan this year, had to divert to Blenheim due to windy conditions, the were 5 on a 12 seater plane, we sat directly behind the pilot and had a great view. Pilot gets in and he looked about 18 years old. He said that it was going to be very bumpy from take off and for the first ten minutes, as soon as the wheels left the ground we started to rock and roll this lasted for 20 minutes, but what a experience, the pilot did a great job could not fault him, would I recommend this and do it again, hell yes every time great service from start to finish
reviews.author: Burtondave

reviews.title: Rude staff.  Extremely rude woman on phone
reviews.text: Emailed and called enquiring about a flight. Wow. This woman was incredibly rude and aggressive when I called and asked a simple question. I asked for the manager and she really cranked it up. If this is how they allow staff to speak with paying customers I can’t imagine how the staff are treated. I flew regularly with this company. Will go with Air NZ from now on.
reviews.author: SuzyG529

reviews.title: A great way to cross the Strait
reviews.text: 1st time travelling with Soundsair and was very impressed. Friendly professional Pilot and Ground Staff. Super convenient to leave Nelson and be on the ground in Paraparaumu within 40 minutes. Price competitive and NO Wellington traffic! Will definitely travel Soundsair in the future. Thanks :)
reviews.author: Rosandy

reviews.title: Easy flight to Wellington
reviews.text: Easy, convenient flight. Great pilots. Friendly crew. Effortless flying and worked smoothly on both ends of the flight.
reviews.author: Nancy L

reviews.title: best airline
reviews.text: one of the best airlines in the world need to be more know in the world the svere was great and when the pilot said i could sat in the front and all so you can see for ever out of the windows
reviews.author: anne_clifford

reviews.title: The most helpful staff
reviews.text: I had a claustrophobia attack and had to leave the plane, the staff were amazing. Thankyou for helping me so much. The woman with the dark ponytail who organised alternative travel, made me a cuppa and helped me to feel normal again. Sorry i cannot remember her name, she certainly was amazing.
reviews.author: J Wells

reviews.title: Great way to cross the Cook Straight
reviews.text: I went on a sunrise flight at 7.25am. Easy check in (nice and casual), departed bang on time and sat right behind the pilot for an front and all around view. Wonderful views at low altitude flying, with an eye opening experience landing in Wellington. A must for flight enthusiasts (small 12 seater plane) and a wonderful way for visitors to get a sense of the Sounds from the air. The pilot was friendly and all in all a highly recommended way to cross. Nervous flyers may want to consider carefully though as it is a small and intimate plane, and you may feel more turbulence and bumps than the larger planes.
reviews.author: Jacki H

reviews.title: Daytime flight
reviews.text: Beautiful day for flying. 25 minutes across Cook Straight at 4000 feet. Wonderful experience. Friendly staff and pilot.
reviews.author: Robert C

reviews.title: Best air service
reviews.text: Fly with these guys frequently. Fantastic service, friendly, reliable and relaxed. Pilots and ground staff are marvellous. Love Soundsair. Great asset to our town.
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.title: The Best Airline
reviews.text: I flew from Wellington (North Island) to Picton (South Island) and return during our NZ road trip whilst my husband took our large hired motorhome across on the ferry - due to my dislike of sailing. As an elderly female travelling on my own Soundsair could not have looked after me better. I caught the "Airport Flyer" shuttle bus from the bus hub at Wellington Railway Station (every 10 minutes) to the airport. There were just 4 of us travelling on a small Cessna plane and the views across the Cook Straight on the 30 minute flight were unbelievably beautiful. Picton airport is a few kilometres from Picton itself so for a small fee Soundsair provided a minibus shuttle into town where I successfully met up with my husband and the motorhome. For the return trip the minibus again provided the shuttle (a really friendly and helpful driver who will go out of his way to deliver you to your preferred drop-off). The weather was atrocious for the return trip so we actually departed from Blenheim. Nevertheless Soundsair did everything they could to be helpful. I am a regular traveller on small planes as in the UK I frequently travel from Cornwall to the Isles of Scilly. Including the shuttle, Soundsair charge less than half the amount I pay in the UK for a journey that is twice as far. Soundsair are, without doubt, the perfect small airline.
reviews.author: Les N

reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Checkin is delightful, just give your name, Way your bags and relax. No boarding pass, no allocated seat, everyone gets a window seat Lovely small planes. This is real flying!
reviews.author: HKinsey

reviews.title: Local flight
reviews.text: Fabulous on time flight in 12 seater plane. Great views over the Sound. Personal service. Laid back check in.
reviews.author: Brian Churchill

reviews.title: Great experience on a tiny plane
reviews.text: We had a grest experinece with sounds air. Great staff and great customer experinece. I definitely would recommend them.
reviews.author: Dextermike

reviews.title: Always awesome
reviews.text: Always awesome...great,friendly service. Terrific pilots (they have to be at times I’m sure), always punctual and reliable but casual enough that there are no dramas. Real asset to our town
reviews.author: Richard N

reviews.title: Reliable service - nelson to Wellington
reviews.text: Generally my choice between Nelson and Wellington. All sears are same price whether you're 1st or last booking. Friendly but efficient airline.
reviews.author: KelvinNelson

reviews.title: Fantastic Flight
reviews.text: This small plane was just the best. Only 9 passengers plus crew, but stable and safe. I have a very quick journey with no fuss and two awsome pilots. Thanks
reviews.author: Jeano60

reviews.title: Fantastic service
reviews.text: Return day trip to Blenheim. It's a single prop plane and has the real feel of flying. Brilliant scenery and service.
reviews.author: Jo k

reviews.title: Efficient, Friendly, and Convenient.
reviews.text: I flew down to Blenheim for 3 days work. I live on the coast so it was super convenient from home. Staff were very friendly while being professional and efficient. Nice views from the plane (high wing not in the way). I will go their way again.
reviews.author: Noel B

reviews.title: The Premier Marlborough Sounds Commuter Airline
reviews.text: I have flown with Sounds Air a few times and they have all been good experiences. This is a small plane, only 9-12 passengers, with the luggage weighed prior to departure. I have always found both the ground crew and pilots to be very helpful and friendly. Great views too!
reviews.author: Trevor L

reviews.title: Friendly service, spectacular views, great experience
reviews.text: We flew Taupo-Wellington in a small, single prop plane (I think it was a PC12) on a spectacularly clear, calm morning. The crew were really friendly and it was refreshing to step back into old-fashioned, personal service on an airline. If you sit on the right side of the plane you can get mesmerizing views of Lake Taupo and surrounding mountains and the descent into Wellington is similarly spectacular. We were really lucky with the weather and this trip figures as one of the most visually memorable of all the flights I've been on. Which are many.
reviews.author: Kirsten H

reviews.title: Fabulous flying!
reviews.text: Fabulous flying! I was a little nervous to fly over the windy channel but it turned out to be one of the best parts of our holiday. We were treated to incredible views leaving Wellington and coming in to Picton. Flying was really exciting because we were in a smaller plane, yet felt totally safe. Like a free air tour, really. Highly recommend them. What fun!
reviews.author: Nedi M

reviews.title: Great flights as only live 5 mins from Kapiti airport
reviews.text: Great airline and really friendly service. It’s a 12 seater on a 40 min flight to Nelson and really fab if you live on the coast. Really lovely crossing if it’s fair as flying over the sounds is spectacular. So easy at both end with minimum hassle. Craft interior getting a bit tired but it’s good value from a local airport and very comfrey seats. Great and recommend highly!
reviews.author: aktori

reviews.title: Very relaxing
reviews.text: Maximum 7 passengers plus 1 Pilot.Great views and very good service and advice from the Pilot.A single jet prop aircraft
reviews.author: Odessa4me

reviews.title: Good airline
reviews.text: I have flown with Sounds Air a few times and they have all been good experiences. It is a small plane, only 9 passengers. I have always found both the ground crew and pilots to be very helpful and friendly. One fun thing about he plane is you get a good view of the plane controls and the pilots view
reviews.author: Irish_Kiwi77

reviews.title: Flight to Wellington
reviews.text: This the first time I had flown with Sounds Air and was a little nervous as the aircraft was a small single engine aircraft, and Wellington is notorious for turbulance. However the Captain and co pilot came into the terminal and spoke to us all about the flight which was great as we were able to hear what they said. We were then invited aboard and had a wonderful scenic flight to Wellington. I was very impressed with both the aircraft, a Pilatus C12 and also the crew. Very efficient and friendly. Can't wait until my next flight with them.
reviews.author: BAR

reviews.title: Great (only!) air service to Westport
reviews.text: I've flown with Sounds Air quite a few times and they are invariably punctual, friendly and you feel like youre in good hands. They offer the only service between Wellington and Westport and we're very grateful for it after Air NZ pulled the pin. They're not cheap but you know you're not going to be shunted on to a shuttle bus instead of an airplane for some reason or other (and pay the flight fare!). Recommended!
reviews.author: Richard N

reviews.title: Small Airline Efficiency
reviews.text: Absolutely love the more relaxed, but efficient airline providing a reasonable alternative to the big Corporate Airline. Always competitive on price and never as greedy as our National Carrier.
reviews.author: Lizzie L

reviews.title: Great local airline doing big things
reviews.text: We prefer to fly fly Soundsair whenever we can and have used them for several years now. Originally the airline flew from Picton (Koromiko) to Wellington or Blenheim to Wellington then expanded to several other destinations including Christchurch and Westport. Great service with shuttle pickup/drop off available. Plenty of free car parking at Picton (Koromiko). Soundsair now to Christchurch from Blenheim in a fast comfortable Pilatus aircraft. We have always had excellent service from ground crew and pilots. One of the great attractions is one fare regardless of when you book.
reviews.author: Kiwi

reviews.title: you should try them!
reviews.text: Great staff - from check in, ground staff and pilot. All really friendly, caring and gave great Kiwi service. Thanks a million
reviews.author: VJayTaupo

reviews.title: Great flying with Sounds, Efficient, friendly & easy to deal with
reviews.text: Very helpful to me with my usually large amount of baggage (I travel for work & carry bulky items) - fast & easy routes, no messing! I have done the Wellington, Napier & Christchurch Routes.. Love you Sounds Air!
reviews.author: Sue R

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: I fly Sounds Air whenever possible. It is excellent to have a service provider so close to Picton. The staff are excellent and the service is personal and professional. I love flying in the smaller planes and have always felt confident with the pilots. Sounds air run a shuttle to and from Picton which is handy. The flights are fast and don't cost much more than the ferry considering how much faster you arrive at your destination!
reviews.author: tearohanui

reviews.title: A great little airline
reviews.text: I am a regular customer of Sounds - using them to pop across to Wellington from Blenheim or Picton. The price is always the same, the pilots are friendly, and the planes are cool little Cessna's - a couple of them are ex CIA spy planes! This company provides an invaluable service for the top of the South region and I ope they continue to thrive!
reviews.author: Ed R

reviews.title: Choose Sounds Air first
reviews.text: This privately owned airline has taken on niche routes and flies direct to Blenheim from Napier in 45mins whereas AirNZ took 2 hours and one plane change in Wellington. I think AirNZ would have more flights per day. Our Sounds Air craft today was a Pilatus PC-12 and was very spacious. Beautiful cloudless early morning flight with hardly a bump. The landing was faultless, and it was fascinating to watch, because in this Pilatus you can see straight through the cockpit windows.
reviews.author: Local_Diner840

reviews.title: Quick hop from Westport to Wellington
reviews.text: We had looked at this option to avoid the longish drive across South Island, and Ferry crossing and all told it is excellent Value for money and of course saves a lot of time. Despite extra luggage, because he was not full, he allowed the extra free of charge. Lovely low level flying so not pressurised and fantastic views, free of charge. The usual slightly windy bumpy arrival at "Windy Wellington"
reviews.author: neil2015

reviews.title: No fuss flying.
reviews.text: A small airline that is easy to fly with as there is no fuss and bother. They fly when they say they will (weather permitting) and the staff are always very pleasant and polite. You may have to carry your bag to the plane, but it's worth it.
reviews.author: cherylr05

reviews.title: Wellington to West Coast south Island
reviews.text: We flew with this airline. Had one pilot about 8 seats. He took us over a scenic route right down over the top of south island. was a wonderful flight and pilot was really good at explaining things. It was a way to get through to the train going between coast and Christchurch. took rental car to get through to catch train. really worthwhile. loved it.
reviews.author: 548kayte

reviews.title: Fantastic service always but especially when foggy
reviews.text: I had a Specialist appointment in Wellington at 9.30am and booked on 6.45am flight to ensure arrival well in advance (20 minute flight). Thick fog !!! Got to airport and reassured we would fly when fog lifted and the staff (Molly) and Pilot (Fraser) were fantastic with on-going reassurances, smiles and guessing antics - very calming! We even got on board but missed window of opportunity so off again. Fog lifted slowly - uneventful flight (as always) and I arrived at Specialist rooms 9.30am !! Always book on line as that flight is always $99 on line as no matter whether booked 1 day or 6 months ahead that is the fixed price.
reviews.author: CFD20

reviews.title: Quick and easy
reviews.text: Use Sounds Air whenever visiting the Marlborough region out of Wellington. Great value and make getting to and from Marlborough so quick and easy. Accessing the beautiful Marlborough Sounds or Marlborough wine region from Sydney so easy with direct 3 hour flight into Wellington and then 20 minute or so flight to Picton or Blenheim. The ferry from Wellington is over 3 hours in comparison.
reviews.author: Peter R
